resources.string: Does what you switch on in AdWizz: leaves Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts (and Shorts, Reels and TikTok pages in browsers), closes short-video apps like TikTok and Moj, taps YouTube\'s "Skip" button on ads and mutes ads that can\'t be skipped, mutes Spotify while it plays an ad, and covers sponsored cards in YouTube and Instagram. In apps it only checks which screen is open and the ad player\'s buttons; in browsers it only reads the address bar. It does not read your messages or what you type, and nothing leaves your phone. Pause it any time from AdWizz.
Short videos are blocked by AdWizz
